description: Bordered 3x2 (or 3x1) icon+H3+body feature grid: no card chrome, just a hairline grid of cells. Two separate implementations share this shape: the homepage/persona-pages component, and product/Sections.jsx's FeatureGrid used by waitlist, pricing, and security.
scope: Present on the homepage, all 3 persona pages, /waitlist, /pricing ('Our model'), /security ('Security controls' and 'Documentation', the latter as link cards), and /tools ('standard') — 9 route occurrences total.
implementedBy: src/components/PeopleOps.jsx (home) + src/components/persona-company/Sections.jsx (FeatureSection, persona) + src/components/product/Sections.jsx (FeatureGrid, waitlist/pricing/security) + src/pages/ToolsIndex.jsx (inline FeatureColumns-based grid)

isLinkCard.note: security's Documentation variant renders cells as link cards, no Read-more button

motion.reducedMotionFallback: n/a — no hover state on these cells per spec ("No hover state on these cells")
